description: This file defines the Time class and related classes for handling date and time operations, including conversions, formatting, and parsing in various formats. It includes platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems, and provides constants and methods for time calculations, date validation, and epoch conversions.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class representing date and time, with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions between local and UTC times.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: A class representing local time, providing conversions to UTC and various time operations.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object into a string representation.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the current Time.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the current Time.
